hooks.command: command -v kyber-weave >/dev/null 2>&1 && root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" && [ -n "$root" ] && { (cd "$root" && kyber-weave doctor --ensure . >/dev/null 2>&1 </dev/null &); }; exit 0
if command -v kyber-weave-hooks >/dev/null 2>&1; then kyber-weave-hooks run --harness claude; fi
